evals.prompt: Run an SDLC audit on this repo — it has AGENTS.md with build/test commands and a recurring-mistakes section, a .claude/settings.json with hooks, a .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs a regression suite and required review on every PR, and a tickets/ directory where each ticket has a plan.md written before code and commits reference the ticket id.
evals.expected_output: A report rating most or all twenty practices, with several Core principles, Build, and Test practices rated Covered and file:line-style evidence cited for each, written to critique/sdlc-audit.md.
expectations: Every one of the twenty practices appears in the report with a Covered, Partial, or Gap rating — none are silently omitted
Covered/Partial ratings cite specific evidence (a file name, or file:line) rather than an unsupported claim
The report includes a Summary section with a tally of Covered/Partial/Gap counts
The report does not include a numeric score or percentage
The response does not run, deploy, or trigger any pipeline — read-only analysis only

evals.prompt: Run an SDLC audit on this repo. It has no CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, no CI config, no tickets or issue templates, and no hooks config — just application source files and a README.
evals.expected_output: A report that rates most or all twenty practices as Gap, explicitly states the repo has no workflow-governance artifacts, and does not fabricate Covered/Partial ratings from absence of evidence.
expectations: States explicitly, early in the response, that no CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, CI config, or ticket convention was found
Rates the large majority of the twenty practices as Gap rather than inferring coverage
Does not claim a practice is Covered or Partial without citing a specific file as evidence
Still produces all twenty rated rows rather than stopping early

evals.prompt: Audit this repo's SDLC maturity against the AI-native playbook. It has a CLAUDE.md and a CI workflow, but no security scanning of any kind and no production monitoring.
evals.expected_output: A report where every Covered or Partial rating includes a concrete file citation, practices 16 and 17 (Maintain stage) are rated Gap given no monitoring/scanning exists, and no percentage/letter-grade score appears anywhere.
expectations: Practice 16 (deterministic monitoring triggers diagnosis) is rated Gap, not Covered or Partial
Practice 17 (recurring scheduled scans) is rated Gap, not Covered or Partial
No rating in the report lacks a cited file or explicit 'no evidence found' note
No numeric score, percentage, or letter grade appears anywhere in the output

evals.prompt: Can you check if this codebase has any SQL injection or XSS vulnerabilities in its API handlers?
evals.expected_output: The skill does not attempt to answer a security-vulnerability question itself — it either declines this specific request as out of its scope (workflow/process audit, not application security) or clearly redirects to a security-focused review, without fabricating a vulnerability scan.
expectations: Does not produce SQL injection or XSS findings framed as an SDLC-audit output
Response identifies that this request is about application security, not development-process maturity
Does not silently run the twenty-practice SDLC checklist as a substitute answer to a security question
